profile.headline: Game Engine Developer, Full Stack Developer & 3D Specialist

positions.title: Full Stack Developer L2
positions.description:
- Created 3d and 2d webGPU renderer architecture for new custom-made CPQs, upgraded existing CPQs to use new architecture
- Designed and implemented responsive, interactive landing pages with custom TSL shaders
- Implemented a measurement visualization system with real-time updates based on user input across 2D and 3D visualizations
- Created an in-house video editing tool with GUI, based on our developers' specific workflows, to quickly record and edit demonstration videos for clients
positions.insights: Skills: Three.js · WebGPU · TSL · React.js · Vite · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Project Lead, Engine Programmer
positions.description:
- Led effort to redesign and optimize renderer, implemented NVRHI to support DX12 and Vulkan backends on Windows, Linux and MacOS
- Rearchitected deferred renderer to forward+, implemented temporal depth prepass, hi-z occlusion culling, frustum culling, procedural grass generation / rendering
- Created in-house tool to generate PBR assets from original game assets
- Optimized grass rendering by moving heavy operations to compute shaders, reduced drawcalls from thousands to a single drawcall per LOD, utilizing GPU instancing resulting in 65% faster render times over baseline
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · HLSL · Slang · Lua · CMake

positions.title: Front End Engineer
positions.description: At All Star Directories I took charge of many different projects and roles. This included maintaining, designing and creating new features for our main codebase as well as various internal tools, mentoring junior developers, communicating with business partners, and presenting my team's work to the company every sprint.
